name: CameraLens
type: { fovY: number, nearZ: number, farZ: number }
doc: perspective projection settings for a camera entity

name: CameraOrbit
type: { distance: number, smoothDistance: number, smoothSideOffset: number, fade: number }
doc: third-person orbit camera controls; smoothed fields are written by the rig

name: CameraFly
type: { smoothDistance: number, smoothSideOffset: number, fade: number, [string]: number }
doc: free-camera yaw, pitch, and zoom controls

name: Screen
doc: the output screen whose ViewSource selects the active camera

name: Camera
doc: the active camera entity selected by the screen ViewSource
